text.title: 窗边的海报
text.situation:
阳光照到最后一张海报上，让文字难读。萨姆拉过一部分窗帘，减弱眩光。海报属于一个促进健康生活的宣传活动，问访客平常一天坐着多久。一段文字用“久坐的生活方式”描述坐着很多、体力活动较少的生活模式。

访客：今天我是有意识地决定步行来的。我想离开书桌一会儿。
萨姆：这是你来看这个展示的原因吗？
访客：对。我对人们怎样保持身体健康感兴趣，不过一张海报不能回答所有问题。
萨姆：窗边有中心讲座的传单。你可以问组织者，每场讲座介绍什么。

paragraphs.en: Sunlight fell across the last poster and made it difficult to read. Sam pulled the curtain partway across the window to counteract the glare. The poster was part of a campaign to promote healthy living. It asked visitors how much of an ordinary day they spent sitting. One paragraph used sedentary lifestyle to describe a pattern with a great deal of sitting and little physical activity.

paragraphs.en:
Visitor: I made a conscious decision to walk here today. I wanted time away from my desk.
Sam: Was that the reason you came to this display?
Visitor: Yes. I am interested in how people maintain a healthy body, though one poster cannot answer everything.
Sam: There is a leaflet about the centre’s talks beside the window. You can ask the organisers what each talk covers.

S10.E07.P01.cue: 解释窗帘和宣传活动的目的。
acceptableAnswers: 窗帘减弱眩光。宣传活动旨在促进健康生活。

S10.E07.P02.cue: 描述生活方式术语和访客的选择。
acceptableAnswers: 海报描述久坐生活方式。访客有意识地决定步行。

S10.E07.P03.cue: 说明访客对什么感兴趣。
acceptableAnswers: 她想讨论人们怎样保持身体健康。

S10.E07.T01.cue: 描述你对自己这一天有意作出的决定。
acceptableAnswers: 我有意识地决定在户外度过下午。
